title: Gary Moore - Empty Rooms
source: Ultimate Guitar official chord chart (user-supplied PDF)
notes: ZERO power chords in the entire chart. Every chord is a triad or a slash chord over a triad. This is the counterpart to the Airbourne song (which is all power chords) and the direct test of CHORD_POWER_THIRD_ABSENCE_RATIO: any '5' the pipeline emits here is wrong.

The chart's 13 shapes are Dm, C/D, Bb, C/Bb, C, F, Gm, Am, G, Em, E, Bb/D, D. Slash chords are reduced to their upper triad for scoring, because the chord ribbon has no slash vocabulary and naming the upper structure is the right answer for it: C/D -> C, C/Bb -> C, Bb/D -> Bb.
Bb is written A# here because the app names pitch classes with sharps (KEY_NOTE_NAMES).
Distinct roots: D, C, A#, F, G, A, E - seven.
Body of the song is a Dm - C/D vamp; pre-chorus F C Gm Bb C Dm; chorus C Gm Bb C Dm; solos move through Am F G Em / Am F G C / G F Dm E.
Contains no dominant sevenths, so it does not exercise the CD-5 seventh gate - Hotel California's F#7 does.
